ekam'id'āhaṃ, ānanda, samayaṃ tatth'eva rājagahe viharāmi gotamanigrodhe
ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena, nikkāmino gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha, laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.
suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ buddhagatā sati.
ko ime dhamme anavasesaṃ pahāya vattati, gotamasāvakasaṅgho vā, pare vā pana bhonto gaṇ'ācariyasāvakasaṅghā'ti?
ekam'antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
suddh'odano mahārājā, gotamī ca pajāpatī, abhiññātā mahātherā, theriyo ca mah'iddhikā.
na jaṭāhi na gottena, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo, yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, so sucī so ca brāhmaṇo.
yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

25285.meaning1: belonging to a family clan; of lineage

examples.text: so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti.

25286.meaning1: proud of one's family clan; arrogant about one's ancestry
25286.commentary: (SNPa) jātitthaddho nāma yo, ahaṃ jātisampanno'ti mānaṃ janetvā tena thaddho vātapūritabhastā viya uddhumāto hutvā na kassaci onamati. esa nayo dhanagottatthaddhesu.

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

25288.meaning1: who place value on ancestry; who value family lineage
25288.commentary: (MNa) ye gottapaṭisārino'ti ye janetasmiṃ gottaṃ paṭisaranti, ahaṃ gotamo, ahaṃ kassapo'ti, tesu loke gottapaṭisārīsu khattiyo seṭṭho.

examples.text: khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.
yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

25290.commentary: (VINa) gottaleso nāma vāsiṭṭho diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ vāsiṭṭhaṃ passitvā codeti, vāsiṭṭho mayā diṭṭho.

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.

25292.meaning1: discussion of family clan; matter of ancestry
25292.commentary: (DNt) gottavādo'ti gottaṃ ārabbha vādo, kassapass'ev'idaṃ vaṭṭati, na kosiyassā'ti-ādi-vacanan'ti attho.

examples.text: na kho, ambaṭṭha, anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya jātivādo vā vuccati, gottavādo vā vuccati, mānavādo vā vuccati, arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ, na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasī'ti.

25293.meaning2: attached to matters of family clan

examples.text: ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā, ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya.

25295.meaning2: change-of-lineage (state of consciousness preceding jhāna or path)

25296.commentary: (THa) yathā'pi bhaddo'ti-ādikā āyasmato godattattherassa gāthā. kā uppatti? ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ satthavāhakule nibbatto. godatto'ti nāmena vayappatto pitari kālaṅ'kate kuṭumbaṃ saṇṭhapento pañcahi sakaṭasatehi bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya apar'āparaṃ sañcaritvā vāṇijjena jīvikaṃ kappeti yathāvibhavaṃ puññāni'pi karoti. so ekadivasaṃ antarāmagge dhure yuttagoṇe vahituṃ asakkonte patite manussesu taṃ vuṭṭhāpetuṃ asakkontesu sayam'eva gantvā taṃ naṅguṭṭhe gāḷhaṃ vijjhi. goṇo ayaṃ asappuriso mama bal'ābalaṃ ajānanto gāḷhaṃ vijjhatī'ti kuddho manussavācāya, bho godatta, ahaṃ ettakaṃ kālaṃ attano balaṃ aniguhanto tuyhaṃ bhāraṃ vahiṃ, ajja pana asamatthabhāvena patitaṃ maṃ ativiya bādhasi, hotu, ito cavitvā nibbatta-nibbatta-ṭṭhāne taṃ bādhetuṃ samattho paṭisattu bhaveyyan'ti patthan'ānurūpena akkosi. taṃ sutvā godatto evaṃ nāma satte bādhetvā kiṃ imāya jīvikāyā'ti saṃvegajāto sabbaṃ vibhavaṃ pahāya aññatarassa mahātherassa santike pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto nacirass'eva arahattaṃ patvā samāpattisukhena vītināmento ekadivasaṃ attano santikaṃ upagatānaṃ gahaṭṭhapabbajitānaṃ ariyagaṇānaṃ lokadhamme ārabbha dhammaṃ kathento
25296.notes: Theragāthā verses 659-672 (TH14.2, TH245) are attributed to him.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā godatto etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, gahapati, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'atthā nānābyañjanā udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
godamakena, bhikkhave, godammo sārito ekaṃ'y'eva disaṃ dhāvati, puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vā.
